checkpoint_selection: highest validation macro Dice at threshold 0.50, evaluated after every epoch
test_policy: each held-out test fold is evaluated once after checkpoint and threshold lock

configs.attunet_cl_fixed: Attention U-Net; 0.2 BCE + 0.8 Dice + 0.3 corrected soft-clDice for epochs 1-50
configs.attunet_cl_schedule: Attention U-Net; fixed loss for epochs 1-25; BCE weight changes from 0.2 to 0.4 for epochs 26-50
